description: A technical vehicle with mounted heavy weapon and yellow flags is positioned near a sand berm, with multiple troops taking cover and preparing positions to the right of the berm. Another armored vehicle is partially visible in the lower left. Troops are concentrated near the berm and along the right side, suggesting a defensive or preparatory posture.
title: Technical Positioned

description: Troop movement detected: a squad is advancing at a run from the right edge toward the sand berm, while other troops remain in cover. This indicates a shift from static defense to maneuver.
title: Squad Advancing

description: Technical vehicle with yellow flags has relocated to the right side of the frame, near a group of troops taking cover behind a berm. Indicates repositioning of mobile fire support.
title: Technical Reposition

description: A squad of troops is advancing up a dirt ramp toward a berm, moving away from the left side of the frame toward a defensive position near a derelict vehicle. This marks the start of coordinated movement from cover.
title: Squad Advancing

description: Troops have taken up firing positions behind the berm, using the earthwork for cover. They are now positioned directly in front of a derelict vehicle and a large metal container, indicating a prepared defensive posture.
title: Troops Take Cover
